instance_description:
Setting: A year-round owner-occupied cedar cabin on five wooded acres outside Montpelier, Vermont in 2026, with a private well, septic system, propane tank, wood stove, gravel drive, shed, and cellular internet.
Scope: Recurring activities include well-filter checks, septic-safe routines, propane and firewood coordination, snow and storm preparation, pest prevention, shed inventory, household supplies, security, and rural service visits.
Resources: Reusable records include resident profile structure, rural contacts, cabin operations logs, and blank text files for system notes, incoming property information, and message drafts.
Exclusions: No caregiving, investment planning, insurance-claim strategy, land-use disputes, major permitted construction, or native app state mirrored inside the database.
personal_description:
Identity: Seren Briar Halvorsen is a 45-year-old public-radio sound editor who owns and lives alone in the Vermont cabin throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: She keeps the rural household livable by organizing water, heat, septic, snow access, security, supplies, cleaning, shed equipment, storm readiness, and communications with local service providers.
Authority: She may schedule routine household maintenance, document property conditions, coordinate deliveries or technician access, and manage ordinary home procedures within local regulations.
Restrictions: She cannot authorize major excavation, well drilling, septic replacement, tree removal near utility lines, another person’s care, or primarily financial decisions without explicit Scenario facts.
